name: r5_nohole_write_056
command:
import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess,sys
p=Path.cwd();s=(p/'src/URMatchingHoleUnion.lean').read_text().replace('end URMatching','''/-- There is an actual unconditioned tuple with no a-square hole.
This does not impose or assert any short-cycle bound. -/
theorem exists_no_large_hole (a : ℕ) (ha : 0 < a) :
    ∃ f : PermutationTuples (4*a) 100,
      ∀ A B : Finset (Fin (4*a)), A.card = a → B.card = a →
        ∃ c, ∃ x ∈ A, f c x ∈ B := by
  classical
  have hs := strict_hole_estimate a ha
  have hex : ∃ f : PermutationTuples (4*a) 100, f ∉ holeEvent (4*a) a := by
    by_contra h
    have hu : holeEvent (4*a) a = Finset.univ := by
      apply Finset.eq_univ_of_forall
      intro f
      by_contra hf
      exact h ⟨f, hf⟩
    rw [hu, Finset.card_univ] at hs
    omega
  obtain ⟨f, hf⟩ := hex
  refine ⟨f, fun A B hA hB => ?_⟩
  by_contra h
  apply hf
  refine Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ f, ⟨⟨(A,B), hA, hB⟩, ?_⟩⟩
  intro c x hx hB'
  exact h ⟨c, x, hx, hB'⟩
end URMatching''')
subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',str(p/'write_lane.py'),'src/URMatchingHoleUnion.lean'],input=s,text=True,check=True)
